description: This file defines a Spring Boot configuration class 'WebCorsConfig' that sets up global CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) policies for the backend API. It specifies allowed origins, methods, headers, and other CORS settings to enable cross-origin requests from specific trusted domains, primarily for frontend-backend communication.

classes.name: WebCorsConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that implements WebMvcConfigurer to configure CORS settings globally for the API.

methods.name: addCorsMappings
methods.description: Overrides the default method to set up detailed CORS policies, including allowed origins, methods, headers, and other settings.
